name: toggle-button
title: Toggle button
description: A button that stays pressed or not, alone or in a group where one or several options are on.

when: Turning a formatting or view option on and off.
Picking options from a short group (ToggleGroup).

instead.when: The choice is a setting that applies immediately.

keyboard.does: Moves between buttons in a group.

builtIn: The pressed state is announced; the label never changes with the state.
